card.name: Linking words inside dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or qualifiers (in, upon, especially, when, if, on, distance) that come right after a dose, rate or amount in dosing directions. It also fires on a few similar connectors in general text.

modes.label: Connector after dose
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction follows a dose or administration phrase and introduces a condition.
modes.example: Hydrochlorothiazide can be given at doses of 12.5 to 50 mg per day<< when>> used alone.

modes.label: Dilution and dosing phrases
modes.description: A linking word within an administration or usage instruction.
modes.example: Administer by intravenous infusion after dilution based<< upon>> recommended infusion rate for each indication.

modes.label: General text phrases
modes.description: Words in ordinary phrases such as walking distance or stages of a disease.
modes.example: within easy walking<< distance>> of each other
